Privacy Policy

Last updated: [DATE]

Summary: We collect the minimum needed to run the game — an account email if you sign up, purchase entitlements, and anonymous crash/usage telemetry. We do not sell your data. Voice chat is transient and never recorded by us. You can play pass-the-phone mode without any account at all.

Who we are

Pants on Fire: Find the Liar is operated by [COMPANY NAME], registered in [JURISDICTION]. For any privacy question or request, contact [CONTACT EMAIL].

What we collect and why

  • Account data (optional). If you create an account, we store your email address and a display name via our authentication provider (Supabase). We use this to sign you in and restore your purchases. Passwords are handled by Supabase and never stored by us in plaintext.
  • Purchase entitlements. When you buy a tier or content pack in the mobile app, our payment provider (RevenueCat, backed by the Apple App Store / Google Play) notifies our server which content your account has unlocked. We store the unlocked entitlement identifiers against your account ID. We never see or store your card details.
  • Game session data. Online lobbies store player display names, scores, and round state for the duration of a game session. Lobby data is deleted when the lobby ends or all players leave.
  • Crash reports and usage telemetry. We collect anonymous error reports (error message, stack trace, browser type, page URL) and coarse usage events (e.g. "a lobby was created", player counts) to keep the game working. These are keyed to a random per-session identifier, not your account. We cap and rate-limit what a device may send.
  • Voice chat (optional). Party voice chat is carried by LiveKit in real time. We do not record, store, or transcribe voice audio.
  • Local storage. Settings, theme unlocks, and session tokens are kept in your browser's local storage on your device. They stay on your device.

What we do NOT do

  • We do not sell or rent personal data to anyone.
  • We do not use third-party advertising or tracking networks.
  • We do not record voice chat.
  • We do not read or store chat message content beyond live delivery.

Third-party processors

  • Supabase — authentication and entitlement storage.
  • RevenueCat — in-app purchase management (mobile app only).
  • Apple App Store / Google Play — payment processing (mobile app only).
  • LiveKit — real-time voice transport (optional feature).
  • Sentry (if enabled) — error monitoring. Receives error reports including browser type and app version.
  • [HOSTING PROVIDER, e.g. Railway] — server hosting.

Age requirements and mature content

The game is intended for players aged 13 and over. The optional 18+ mode unlocks adult-themed prompts and must only be enabled where every player in the session is 18 or older. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13; if you believe a child has created an account, contact us and we will delete it.

Data retention

  • Lobby/session data: deleted when the lobby ends.
  • Account and entitlement data: kept while your account exists.
  • Telemetry logs: retained for up to 90 days, then deleted.

Your rights

Depending on where you live (including under GDPR and CCPA), you may have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data, and to object to or restrict certain processing. To exercise any of these rights, email [CONTACT EMAIL]. We will respond within 30 days. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data-protection authority.

Changes to this policy

We will post any changes on this page and update the "Last updated" date. For significant changes we will show a notice in the game.
